pages.en:
“You used a Command Spell yesterday, didn't you? Then this time it's my turn.

“I'll summon Saber first. If even she can't handle it, you can call Archer then! Now, how do I use a Command Spell!?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You used your Command Spell yesterday. So it’s my turn today.
We can call for Archer if Saber can’t handle the situation by herself! So, how do I use the Command Spell!?”

pages.ja:
「
左手に意識を固めて。目は瞑った方がいい。
頭の中で自分の令呪の形をイメージして、するっと紐解くだけでいいわ。もちろん、解く時は命令をしながらよ」

“…Concentrate your awareness in your left hand. It will be easier with your eyes closed.

“Picture the shape of your Command Spell in your mind, then simply let it unravel. And naturally, you must speak your command as you release it.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Concentrate on your left hand. It’s better if you close your eyes.
Imagine the shape of your Command Spell and release it. Give an order while you release it, of course.”

pages.en:
I close my eyes.

There is no time to waste.

In the briefest instant, I clear my mind of every stray thought,

reach for the second stroke,

and—

“—Please. Come to me, Saber——!”

without hesitation, release the Command Spell upon my left hand.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I close my eyes.
I can’t take my time.
I eliminate any thoughts in my head as quickly as I can,
concentrate on my second Command Spell,
“Please. Come, Saber!!!!”
…And I release the Command Spell without any hesitation.

“Uh… I can’t say for sure, but that’s what I feel.
The source of the boundary field has to be on the first floor.”

“He won't answer me, no matter how many times I call! This bounded field completely seals the inside away from the outside. Only a Command Spell can reach him—unless he senses what's happened here and comes running on his own.”
